$comment: The v1.3 line's release-candidate tag for its PARALLEL compat credential window (founder decision 2026-10-08; four stable cells node/bun x turbopack/webpack, vinext Beta and uncredentialed). Independent of .github/compat-credential-ref.json, which pins the v1.0 window: a v1.3 bump restarts only the v1.3 window. Read from main by .github/workflows/compat-credential-v1.3.yml via scripts/compat-credential-line.mjs, which REFUSES a tag not on the v1.3 line. Bumping rcTag requires regenerating that workflow from the new tag in the same PR (docs/RELEASING.md).

publishedBytesBumpMarker.reason: Lead-delegated 2026-10-14 (UTC), the next/image backport to the 1.3 line (#2362, from #2361 on integration/v2), applying the same scoped-marker rule as the 1.3.1 PPR backport. It changes @getknext/core's shipped bytes relative to v1.3.0-rc.10: dist/adapters/standalone-compile.mjs keeps sharp on disk beside the compiled executable, and the CLI chunks stage the image platform's linuxmusl sharp pair into the standalone tree (lockfile readers for bun, npm, pnpm and Yarn 1; host-copy version check). Like 1.3.0 and 1.3.1, the resulting patch ships decoupled from the credential: the window keeps measuring the rc.10 bytes and no verified claim covers it until a credential cycle runs on it. rcTag is unchanged. Distinct date and reason from the inherited 1.3.1 marker, so the introduced-by-this-PR rule reads it as new.
